sourceIdentity.rawGeometryHashQualification: Fresh PBF GeoJSONFactory yields a MultiPolygon wrapper; historical cache uses its simplified single Polygon representation. Original fresh/cache shapes are exactly equal as geometric sets; hashes must be bound to their specified serialization, not interchanged.
sourceIdentity.interpretation: The uncoded administrative feature names the unique official175155 imada; there is no distinct current imada or source code supporting a second sector. Its exact clone of the misassigned Medina geometry is a source error, not proof that Medina and Cheikh are aliases.
